verdictRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Measured: 0 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX, 2 advisories.

shouldFix.title: An upheld finding's repair has no defined confirmation step
shouldFix.where: Decision 4: 'Its retained digest-pinned ruling binds the surviving finding IDs: uphold (author repairs), dismiss (finding clears), or unresolved (remains CONTESTED).'
shouldFix.defect: When the adjudicator upholds a finding, the author repairs it, but the unit has already consumed its three exchanges. The text does not say who verifies the repair or whether that verification is an exchange. Two readings survive: the repaired unit is adopted on the author's word (self-certification, which clause 1 forbids), or it re-enters review as a fourth exchange (which clause 4 forbids).
shouldFix.consequence: The first upheld finding will itself be contested on procedure, and a SATISFIED recorded on an unverified repair is attackable for provenance.
shouldFix.evidenceToResolve: Add one sentence: an upheld finding's repair is verified in exactly one bounded confirmation exchange, limited to the repair diff against the ruling, by the adjudicator (or by the original reviewer if the adjudicator is unavailable); that confirmation does not count toward the three-exchange limit; a repair that fails confirmation returns the unit to CONTESTED and D-000 clause 2 batching.

advisories.title: State that the checker mandate is prospective and how already-recorded corpora meet it
advisories.note: Clause 1's 'Every fixture corpus includes a retained checker and a digest-pinned passing report at recording' reads as a universal; clause 6 says adoption changes no fixture obligation. Say expressly: the mandate applies to recordings from adoption forward, and a SATISFIED package that cites a corpus recorded earlier without a checker supplies the checker and passing report as part of that row's evidence (claude-initial-audit.md §3 finish line item 2). Not a bar because clause 6 already fixes the non-retroactivity of adoption itself.

advisories.title: Freeze the adjudication dispatch text
advisories.note: Clause 4 freezes the subject, positions and verdicts the adjudicator receives; the dispatch text that frames the question is not listed. Freezing and digest-pinning it (as _dispatch.*.txt has been for reviews) prevents a later dispute about what was asked.
